title: Design System: Doula Cooperative public site

display.purpose: Page h1 (--step-5). Centered on interior pages, start-aligned on the home hero.

title.purpose: h3, the home guiding question, panel titles (--step-2).

subtitle.purpose: Card and row titles, the wordmark (--step-1).

label.purpose: Form labels, legends, counts, back link, small buttons (--step--1, 600).

caption.purpose: Chips in cards, wordmark place line, doula counts (--step--2).

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: Hover on linked cards and choices; at rest on the one action panel of a page (profile contact, membership join).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour, border and shadow changes on hover and focus.

motion.name: arrow-slide
motion.purpose: The arrow icon moves 0.2em on hover of its link, card or row. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Cross-page transitions; shared names on card photo, name and chips. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like the find-a-provider directories a Family already knows: Psychology Today's directory, Zocdoc, Oula and Tia. The user chose the category standard on purpose ("we need to follow Jakob's law"). There is no metaphor and no concept world. A sticky white header carries a wordmark, three links and one Find a Doula button; pages are a warm ivory ground with white cards for people and controls; the footer is a deep teal block.

Density is moderate and content-first: one typeface, a calm two-hue palette (teal for action, warm neutrals for ground), real headshots as the only imagery besides the home photograph. Emphasis comes from weight and size, never from decoration. WCAG 2.2 AA is binding.
keyCharacteristics: Conventional directory patterns: provider cards, service chips, search box, tabs, numbered steps, plain forms.
Warm ivory ground, white surfaces, deep teal ink and action, one clay band.
One typeface (Geologica) at 400 for reading and 650 for headings.
12px surfaces, pill-shaped actions and chips, 1px warm hairlines.
One soft shadow, used for hover on linked cards and for the single action panel on a page.
Layout responds to container width, not viewport width.

rules.name: The Control Border Rule
rules.body: Anything a Family types into or picks from is bounded by `control-border`, never `line` or `line-strong`. It is the only neutral border that reaches 3:1.

rules.name: The One Clay Rule
rules.body: Clay appears once per page at most, as a full-width band. It is not a button colour, a text colour or a chip colour elsewhere.

rules.name: The 52ch Rule
rules.body: The reading column is `52ch`, as are the page CTA, the callout and the hub intro. Geologica's `0` is wide, so 52ch sets about 70 characters a line. Short supporting copy runs narrower (40-44ch). Copy outside the reading column is capped at 60-65ch in the build (steps, home section paragraphs, the profile bio).

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Geologica only. A second typeface needs the user's approval first.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: `--shadow-raised` is the only shadow. It means "this whole surface is a link, and you are on it" or "this is the panel where you act". Sand panels, callouts, the header and inputs carry none.

dos: Do use the patterns Families know from provider directories: card with headshot, name, credentials and chips; search box with a button; tabs; plain labelled forms.
Do use `--color-control-border` for every input, fieldset and selectable card boundary.
Do put long-form prose in the reading column at `52ch`.
Do keep doula photos 1:1; at `26rem` and wider the photo sets the card height, with text clamped to fit beside it.
Do make a card or row one link, named by its title, with the whole surface as the target.
Do size layouts with container queries and the `--space-*` scale.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: arrow slides, card transitions and page view transitions switch off.
Do use the semantic `--color-*` tokens in new CSS.
donts: Don't introduce a metaphor or concept-driven visual world; the site follows Jakob's Law.
Don't add a second typeface without the user's approval.
Don't use `line` or `line-strong` as the only boundary of a control; neither reaches 3:1.
Don't use Clay outside the one full-width band.
Don't add a second shadow, or put the Raised shadow on a surface that is neither a linked card nor the page's action panel.
Don't write new CSS against the `--brown-*` / `--teal-*` aliases.
Don't let card text grow a card of `26rem` or wider past its photo, or drop services silently: the "+N more" count stays visible.
Don't carry this system into `members/` or `admin/`; they are out of scope.
